entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If a huge castle like that really exists,[n]I'm sure we'll find it in no time.
entries.uk: Якщо такий величезний замок справді[n]існує, ми його вмить знайдемо.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We walked that way from here, right?
entries.uk: Ми ж ішли туди звідси, так?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: When you put it that way, I'm not so sure[n]anymore...
entries.uk: Як ти так кажеш, я вже[n]не дуже певен...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't be like that. It'll be over quick.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Lemme know if you notice something.
